name: SQL Minifier
summary: Minify SQL to a single line — strip comments and collapse whitespace locally.
description: Paste SQL to collapse whitespace into a one-liner. Optionally remove -- line comments and /* block */ comments while preserving string literals. See original vs minified character counts. Runs entirely in your browser.

faqs.question: Does it remove comments?
faqs.answer: Yes by default. Uncheck Strip comments to keep -- and /* */ comments while still collapsing whitespace.

faqs.question: Are string literals safe?
faqs.answer: Yes. Quoted strings are protected so comment-like text inside them is not removed.

faqs.question: Need pretty formatting instead?
faqs.answer: Use SQL Formatter to expand clauses onto readable lines.

faqs.question: Is my SQL uploaded?
faqs.answer: No. Minifying runs entirely in your browser.
